summary: MOTUS GI HOLDINGS INC is a medical technology company focused on improving patient outcomes through the development and commercialization of the Pure-Vu System. The Pure-Vu System is designed to facilitate the cleaning of a poorly prepared colon during a colonoscopy. Motus GI Holdings is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.

name: Mowi ASA
summary: Mowi ASA, a seafood company, produces and supplies farmed salmon products worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Feed, Farming, and Sales and Marketing. It is involved in the salmon feed production, salmon farming and primary processing, and seafood secondary processing activities. The company offers whole gutted fish, including Label Rouge and organic salmon; and white fish and other seafood products, as well as fillets, steaks, cutlets, portions, loins, kebabs, and steak combos. It also provides value added products, such as breaded, pre-fried, dusted, marinated, grilled, battered, topped, filled with sauce, delicatessen, fresh fish ready meal, and smoked fish products. The company offers its products under the Mowi, Appeti'Marine, Mowi Salmon, Donegal Silver, Admiral's, Pieters, Laschinger, Kritsen, Ducktrap River, Harbour Salmon Co., Rebel Fish, Supreme Salmon, Olav's, Northern Harvest, and Mowi Nutrition brand names. The company was formerly known as Marine Harvest ASA and changed its name to Mowi ASA in December 2018. Mowi ASA was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Bergen, Norway.

name: MY SIZE INC
summary: MY SIZE INC is a developer and vendor of e-commerce solutions, specializing in apparel sizing. They developed a mobile app to allow consumers to accurately measure themselves using their smartphone and get personalized size recommendations. My Size Inc. is headquartered in Airport City, Israel.

name: MYOMO INC
summary: MYOMO INC is a medical robotics company that develops and commercializes myoelectric orthotics for individuals with neuromuscular conditions. Their MyoPro device is a powered arm brace that can help restore function to paralyzed or weakened arms and hands. Myomo Inc. is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

name: NOV Inc.
summary: NOV INC is a global provider of equipment and technologies to the energy industry. They design, manufacture, and sell equipment and components used in oil and gas drilling and production operations. NOV is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

name: NanoViricides, Inc.
summary: NANOVIRICIDES INC is a drug development company employing a novel nanobiotechnology platform to create anti-viral drugs. The Company’s therapeutics are designed to specifically attack enveloped virus-infected cells. The company's headquarters are located in Shelton, Connecticut.

name: NANTHEALTH INC
summary: NANTHEALTH INC is a transformational healthcare company converging personalized diagnostics and therapeutics with digital health solutions to empower individuals to live longer, healthier lives. The company provides comprehensive genomic profiling, clinical decision support, and data analytics solutions. NantHealth Inc. is headquartered in Culver City, California.

name: NATHAN'S FAMOUS INC
summary: NATHAN'S FAMOUS INC licenses and franchises the Nathan's Famous brand for restaurants and food products. It is known for its hot dogs and other food items sold through its restaurant and retail channels. Nathan's Famous Inc. is headquartered in Jericho, New York.

name: SPIRE GLOBAL INC
summary: SPIRE GLOBAL INC. is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates a constellation of nanosatellites. It collects Earth data and provides insights and predictive analytics to various industries, headquartered in Vienna, Virginia. The company's services include weather forecasting, maritime intelligence, and aviation tracking, using its satellite-collected data and proprietary algorithms.

name: NCINO OPCO INC
summary: NCINO OPCO INC provides cloud banking and digital lending solutions to financial institutions. Headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina, the nCino Bank Operating System empowers banks and credit unions to deliver a seamless customer experience, increase efficiency, and improve regulatory compliance. The company operates on a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model.

name: NEMAURA MEDICAL INC
summary: NEMAURA MEDICAL INC is a medical technology company focused on developing and commercializing non-invasive wearable diagnostic devices. Headquartered in Loughborough, United Kingdom, their primary product is the sugarBEAT® continuous glucose monitor (CGM) designed for use by individuals with diabetes and pre-diabetes. The device aims to provide real-time glucose data without the need for invasive blood sampling.

name: NEOLEUKIN THERAPEUTICS INC
summary: NEOLEUKIN THERAPEUTICS INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing immunotherapies for cancer, autoimmune, and inflammatory disorders. They are headquartered in Emeryville, California and their lead product candidate is a novel recombinant IL-2/IL-15 agonist designed to selectively activate and expand specific immune cell populations to fight disease. The company aims to improve upon existing IL-2 therapies with potentially enhanced safety and efficacy.

name: NETWORK-1 TECHNOLOGIES INC
summary: NETWORK-1 TECHNOLOGIES INC is a company primarily engaged in the development, licensing, and protection of its intellectual property assets. They focus on patent licensing in areas such as data transmission, wireless technology, and power management, and are headquartered in New York. Their business model involves asserting their patent rights against companies that they believe are infringing on their intellectual property.

name: NEUROMETRIX INC
summary: NEUROMETRIX INC is a medical device company focused on developing and marketing products for the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders. Headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, their products include devices for nerve conduction studies and point-of-care testing for peripheral neuropathy. They aim to improve the diagnosis and management of neurological conditions through innovative and accessible technologies.

name: NEUBASE THERAPEUTICS INC
summary: NEUBASE THERAPEUTICS INC is a biotechnology company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing genetic medicines to treat rare neuromuscular diseases. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, they are developing a platform of peptide-nucleic acid (PNA) based therapies designed to target the underlying genetic causes of these diseases. The company's approach aims to modulate gene expression and restore normal cellular function.

name: NEXTERA ENERGY PARTNERS LP
summary: NEXTERA ENERGY PARTNERS LP is a growth-oriented limited partnership formed by NextEra Energy, Inc. Headquartered in Juno Beach, Florida, it acquires, owns, and operates contracted clean energy projects with stable, long-term cash flows, primarily in North America. These projects include wind and solar projects, as well as natural gas pipelines.

name: NEXIMMUNE INC
summary: NEXIMMUNE INC is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing targeted cancer therapies. Headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland, they are pioneering a novel approach to immunotherapy by using artificial immune modulatory structures (AIMs) designed to educate and direct immune cells to attack cancer. The company's technology platform aims to provide a more precise and effective approach to cancer treatment.

name: NIKOLA CORP
summary: NIKOLA CORP is a company focused on designing and manufacturing zero-emission vehicles and energy solutions. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, they aim to provide battery-electric and hydrogen fuel-cell electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and hydrogen production/dispensing infrastructure. Their business model focuses on creating a sustainable transportation ecosystem.

name: Norsk Hydro ASA
summary: Norsk Hydro ASA operates as an integrated aluminum company worldwide. It operates through six segments: Bauxite & Alumina, Aluminium Metal, Metal Markets, Rolling, Extrusions, and Energy. The Bauxite & Alumina segment engages in bauxite mining activities, production of alumina, and related commercial activities, primarily the sale of alumina. The Aluminium Metal segment is involved in the primary aluminum production, remelting, and casting activities. This segment principally offers extrusion, sheet, and standard ingots, as well as foundry alloys. The Metal Markets segment sells products from the company's primary metal plants; operates remelters; and trades in physical and financial metals. The Rolling segment operates rolling mills and a primary metal plant. This segment principally offers aluminum foils, strips, sheets, and lithographic plates for application in the packaging, automotive, building and general engineering, and transport industries, as well as for offset printing plates. The Extrusions segment offers extrusion profiles, building systems, and precision tubing products for construction, automotive and heating, and ventilation and air conditioning sectors. The Energy segment owns and operates 40 hydroelectric power plants in Norway. Norsk Hydro ASA was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

name: NORTHEAST BANK
summary: NORTHEAST BANK is a financial institution offering a range of banking products and services to individuals and businesses. Headquartered in Lewiston, Maine, the bank provides deposit accounts, loans, and other financial solutions, with a focus on community banking. The company also operates a nationwide lending division.

name: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc.
summary: NORTHERN OIL AND GAS INC is an independent energy company engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and production of oil and natural gas properties. Headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota, the company focuses on non-operated working interests in the Bakken and Three Forks formations in the Williston Basin of North Dakota and Montana. Their strategy involves acquiring and developing these assets to generate production and cash flow.

name: GEN DIGITAL INC
summary: GEN DIGITAL INC is a global company focused on providing digital safety solutions for consumers. Formerly known as NortonLifeLock, the company is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, and offers a range of cybersecurity and privacy products and services under brands such as Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, CCleaner, and ReputationDefender. Gen aims to protect consumers' devices, data, online identity, and home and family needs.

name: OGE Energy Corp.
summary: OGE ENERGY CORP is a public utility holding company with investments primarily in Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company (OG&E). Headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, OG&E is a regulated electric utility that provides electricity to customers in Oklahoma and western Arkansas. OGE Energy also has investments in Enable Midstream Partners, LP, which focuses on natural gas and crude oil gathering, processing, transportation and storage.

name: O-I GLASS INC
summary: O-I GLASS INC is a manufacturer of glass containers. Headquartered in Perrysburg, Ohio, the company produces glass packaging for food, beverages, and other consumer products. O-I operates globally and supplies glass containers to numerous brands and industries.

name: NUWELLIS INC
summary: NUWELLIS INC is a medical device company focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing a portfolio of products targeting fluid overload. Headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, their Aquadex FlexFlow system removes excess fluid from patients suffering from fluid overload. The company aims to improve outcomes and reduce healthcare costs associated with fluid management.

name: RESHAPE LIFESCIENCES INC
summary: RESHAPE LIFESCIENCES INC is a medical technology company focused on developing products and services to address obesity and metabolic diseases. Headquartered in San Clemente, California, they offer the Lap-Band® program for weight loss and other bariatric solutions. The company's goal is to provide effective and less invasive options for individuals struggling with obesity.

name: OCWEN FINANCIAL CORP
summary: OCWEN FINANCIAL CORP is a mortgage servicer and originator. Headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida, the company provides servicing and lending solutions to homeowners and investors. Ocwen aims to help homeowners achieve their financial goals and manage their mortgage obligations.

name: OCUGEN INC
summary: OCUGEN INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing gene therapies to cure blindness diseases. Headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, the company is developing a pipeline of innovative therapies for diseases such as retinitis pigmentosa, dry age-related macular degeneration, and diabetic retinopathy. Ocugen's goal is to restore vision and improve the quality of life for individuals with inherited and age-related eye diseases.

name: OCUPHIRE PHARMA INC
summary: OCUPHIRE PHARMA INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapeutics for diseases of the eye. They are headquartered in Melville, New York and their pipeline includes therapies for conditions such as presbyopia and retinal diseases. The company is working on both small molecule and biologic drug candidates to address unmet needs in ophthalmology.

name: ONCTERNAL THERAPEUTICS INC
summary: ONCTERNAL THERAPEUTICS INC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel oncology therapeutics. They are headquartered in San Diego, California, and their pipeline includes product candidates targeting signal transduction pathways critical for cancer cell growth and survival. The company's goal is to develop more effective and targeted treatments for various types of cancer.

name: ONEMAIN HOLDINGS INC
summary: ONEMAIN HOLDINGS INC is a financial services holding company that provides personal installment loans and insurance products. Headquartered in Evansville, Indiana, the company operates through its subsidiaries, OneMain Financial and Trim Financial, offering financial solutions to non-prime consumers. OneMain focuses on providing responsible and transparent credit options to underserved populations.

name: Onto Innovation, Inc.
summary: ONTO INNOVATION INC is a global leader in process control, combining leading-edge optics, metrology and data analysis software. Headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, it designs, develops, manufactures and supports process control tools used in advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Their solutions include automated 3D metrology, macro defect inspection, and lithography process control.

name: OPTION CARE HEALTH INC
summary: OPTION CARE HEALTH INC provides home and alternate site infusion services. Headquartered in Bannockburn, Illinois, the company offers a range of therapies, including anti-infectives, nutrition support, and immunoglobulin therapy, delivered by nurses and clinicians to patients in their homes or other non-hospital settings. Option Care aims to provide high-quality and cost-effective care in a comfortable and convenient environment.

name: ORGENESIS INC
summary: ORGENESIS INC is a regenerative medicine company focused on developing and commercializing cell therapies for a variety of indications. Headquartered in Germantown, Maryland, their primary product is Grafix, a living cell therapy used to treat chronic wounds. The company aims to address unmet medical needs through innovative regenerative medicine solutions.

name: Organogenesis Holdings, Inc. Class A
summary: ORGANOGENESIS HOLDINGS INC is a regenerative medicine company focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing solutions for the advanced wound care and surgical biologics markets. Headquartered in Canton, Massachusetts, their portfolio includes a variety of products used in the treatment of chronic wounds, surgical reconstruction, and sports medicine. The company aims to improve patient outcomes by providing innovative and clinically effective regenerative medicine products.

name: Oric Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
summary: ORIC PHARMACEUTICALS INC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies that overcome resistance mechanisms in cancer. Headquartered in South San Francisco, California, their pipeline includes small molecule inhibitors targeting key resistance pathways, such as those mediated by glucocorticoid receptor and EED. The company's approach aims to provide more effective and durable treatments for various types of cancer.

name: Otis Worldwide Corporation
summary: OTIS WORLDWIDE CORP is a leading manufacturer, installer, and servicer of elevators, escalators, and moving walkways. Headquartered in Farmington, Connecticut, the company offers its products and services in approximately 200 countries and territories. Otis focuses on providing safe, reliable, and efficient vertical transportation solutions for buildings of all types.

name: Ovintiv Inc. (DE)
summary: OVINTIV INC is an energy company engaged in the exploration, development, and production of natural gas, oil, and natural gas liquids. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, the company's assets are primarily located in the United States and Canada. Ovintiv focuses on delivering sustainable shareholder value through disciplined capital allocation and operational excellence.

name: PC CONNECTION INC
summary: PC CONNECTION INC is a direct marketing reseller of information technology (IT) products and solutions. Headquartered in Merrimack, New Hampshire, the company provides IT products, services, and solutions to businesses, government agencies, and educational institutions. PC Connection operates through its subsidiaries, including PC Connection Sales Corp., GovConnection, Inc., and MoreDirect, Inc.

name: Palantir Technologies Inc. Class A
summary: PALANTIR TECHNOLOGIES INC-A builds and deploys software platforms for data integration, analysis, and operations. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, the company serves government and commercial organizations with its Palantir Gotham and Palantir Foundry platforms. These platforms are designed to help clients make data-driven decisions and improve operational efficiency.

name: PALISADE BIO INC
summary: PALISADE BIO INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapeutics for acute and chronic gastrointestinal (GI) complications. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, their lead product candidate, PALI-210, is an oral formulation designed to protect and repair the intestinal barrier. The company aims to improve outcomes for patients suffering from GI disorders.

name: PAR TECHNOLOGY CORP/DEL
summary: PAR TECHNOLOGY CORP/DEL is a global provider of point-of-sale (POS) solutions, including software, hardware, and services, to the restaurant and retail industries. Headquartered in New Hartford, New York, the company operates through its Brink POS and Punchh subsidiaries, offering solutions to streamline operations, enhance customer engagement, and improve profitability for its clients. Par also provides government and defense solutions.

name: Peloton Interactive, Inc. Class A
summary: PELOTON INTERACTIVE INC-A is a connected fitness company that offers interactive fitness experiences. Headquartered in New York City, the company sells exercise equipment, such as stationary bikes and treadmills, and provides subscription-based access to live and on-demand fitness classes. Peloton aims to provide engaging and convenient fitness solutions for its members.

name: Pennant Group Inc
summary: PENNANT GROUP INC/THE provides healthcare services, primarily in the senior living and home health and hospice sectors. Headquartered in Eagle, Idaho, the company operates through its subsidiaries, which offer assisted living, skilled nursing, home health, and hospice services. Pennant focuses on providing quality care and improving outcomes for its patients.

name: Personalis, Inc.
summary: PERSONALIS INC is a cancer genomics company transforming the development of next-generation cancer therapies. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, the company develops and commercializes comprehensive genomic profiling services for cancer researchers and clinicians. Personalis aims to advance precision medicine in oncology by providing detailed molecular information about individual tumors.

name: PHIO PHARMACEUTICALS CORP
summary: PHIO PHARMACEUTICALS CORP is a biotechnology company focused on developing immuno-oncology therapeutics using its proprietary self-delivering RNAi technology. Headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts, the company's lead product candidate is designed to target immune cells in the tumor microenvironment to enhance anti-tumor immune responses. Phio aims to develop next-generation RNAi therapeutics for the treatment of cancer.

name: Phreesia, Inc.
summary: PHREESIA INC provides a technology platform for the life sciences industry. Headquartered in Yardley, Pennsylvania, their platform facilitates patient access to prescription medications by streamlining the affordability and adherence process, connecting patients, providers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. Phreesia aims to improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.

name: PLAINS GP HOLDINGS LP-CL A
summary: PLAINS GP HOLDINGS LP-CL A is a limited partnership that owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services for crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGL). The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas. Plains GP Holdings LP manages and controls Plains All American Pipeline, L.P.

name: Playtika Holding Corp.
summary: PLAYTIKA HOLDING CORP is a mobile gaming company that develops and publishes free-to-play games. Headquartered in Herzliya, Israel, the company's portfolio includes popular titles in the casual and social casino genres, like Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, and House of Fun. Playtika uses advanced data analytics and live operations to optimize the player experience and drive engagement.

name: PLIANT THERAPEUTICS INC
summary: PLIANT THERAPEUTICS INC is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing novel therapeutics for fibrotic diseases. Headquartered in South San Francisco, California, their lead product candidates are small molecule inhibitors targeting integrins, which play a key role in the fibrotic process. Pliant aims to address unmet medical needs in diseases such as idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC).

name: PLUS THERAPEUTICS INC
summary: PLUS THERAPEUTICS INC is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing targeted radiotherapeutics for the treatment of cancer. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, their lead product candidate is Rhenium-186 Nanoliposome, a liposomal formulation of Rhenium-186, a radioisotope. Plus Therapeutics aims to deliver radiation directly to tumor cells while minimizing damage to healthy tissue.

name: POLAR POWER INC
summary: POLAR POWER INC designs, manufactures, and sells direct current (DC) power systems, lithium-ion battery based power systems, and hybrid power systems comprised of a diesel or gasoline fuelled generator. Headquartered in Gardena, California, its systems are primarily used in the telecommunications, marine, military, and industrial markets. Polar Power's solutions provide reliable and efficient power for critical applications.

name: Pool Corporation
summary: POOL CORP is a wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and related products. Headquartered in Covington, Louisiana, the company operates a network of sales centers across North America, Europe, and Australia, serving professional customers such as pool builders, remodelers, and service technicians. Pool Corp offers a wide range of products, including chemicals, equipment, parts, and construction materials.

name: POSEIDA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
summary: POSEIDA THERAPEUTICS INC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing next-generation therapeutics with cell-penetrating delivery technologies to treat cancer and other diseases. Headquartered in San Diego, California, the company has developed proprietary platforms, including BackPACK™, PENN™, and Unlock™, to create new therapeutics and improve existing therapies. Their technology is designed to deliver payloads directly into cells to address previously undruggable targets.

name: POWERFLEET INC
summary: POWERFLEET INC is a global provider of wireless Internet of Things (IoT) and machine-to-machine (M2M) solutions. Headquartered in Rochelle Park, New Jersey, the company provides fleet management, asset tracking, and workforce management solutions to businesses of all sizes. PowerFleet's solutions help customers improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance safety.

name: Precigen Inc
summary: PRECIGEN INC is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing the next generation of gene and cell therapies to improve the lives of patients with cancer, autoimmune, and infectious diseases. Headquartered in Germantown, Maryland, the company utilizes its AdenoVerse™ technology platform to develop gene therapies and cell therapies that are designed to be more precise, safer, and more effective than traditional approaches. Precigen's pipeline includes product candidates targeting a variety of indications, including solid tumors, hematological malignancies, and autoimmune disorders.

name: PRIMORIS SERVICES CORP
summary: PRIMORIS SERVICES CORP is a specialty construction and infrastructure company. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, the company provides a range of services, including engineering, procurement, construction, and maintenance, to utilities and energy companies. Primoris operates through various subsidiaries, serving markets such as power generation, renewable energy, and natural gas.

name: Protalix Biotherapeutics, Inc.
summary: PROTALIX BIOTHERAPEUTICS INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing recombinant therapeutic proteins based on its proprietary plant cell-based expression system, ProCellEx®. Headquartered in Carmiel, Israel, the company's lead product is Elelyso® (taliglucerase alfa), a plant cell-expressed recombinant glucocerebrosidase enzyme, approved for the treatment of Gaucher disease. Protalix aims to address unmet medical needs in rare diseases through its innovative protein expression technology.

name: Prosus N.V.
summary: Prosus N.V. engages in the e-commerce and internet businesses. It operates internet platforms, such as classifieds, payments and fintech, food delivery, travel, education, etail, health, social, and other internet platforms. It has operations in the Americas, Africa, Central and Eastern Europe, and Asia. The company was formerly known as Myriad International Holdings N.V. and changed its name to Prosus N.V. in August 2019. Prosus N.V. is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Prosus N.V. is a subsidiary of Naspers Limited.

name: Pulmonx Corp.
summary: PULMONX CORP is a medical technology company focused on developing and commercializing minimally invasive devices for patients with severe lung disease. Headquartered in Redwood City, California, the company's Zephyr® Endobronchial Valve is designed to treat severe emphysema by blocking off the most diseased parts of the lung, allowing healthier areas to expand and improve breathing. Pulmonx aims to improve the quality of life for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

name: QCR HOLDINGS INC
summary: QCR HOLDINGS INC is a multi-bank holding company operating in the Quad Cities region of Iowa and Illinois, as well as Cedar Rapids, Des Moines, and Springfield. Headquartered in Moline, Illinois, the company provides a range of commercial and consumer banking services through its subsidiary banks. QCR Holdings focuses on relationship banking and community involvement.

name: Qualtrics International Inc.
summary: QUALTRICS INTERNATIONAL-CL A is a cloud-based survey and experience management company. Headquartered in Provo, Utah, and Seattle, Washington, the company's Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) platform helps organizations collect and analyze data to understand and improve customer, employee, product, and brand experiences. Qualtrics serves a wide range of industries and organizations worldwide.

name: QUICKLOGIC CORP
summary: QUICKLOGIC CORP is a fabless semiconductor company that designs, develops, and markets low-power, multi-core, Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) embedded systems. Headquartered in San Jose, California, the company's FPGAs are used in a variety of applications, including mobile devices, industrial automation, and aerospace and defense. QuickLogic focuses on providing energy-efficient and flexible solutions for embedded systems.

name: Radiant Logistics, Inc.
summary: RADIANT LOGISTICS INC is a third-party logistics company that provides multi-modal transportation and logistics services. Headquartered in Renton, Washington, the company operates through a network of company-owned and agent-owned locations across North America. Radiant Logistics offers a range of services, including domestic and international freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and warehousing and distribution.

name: RAPT THERAPEUTICS INC
summary: RAPT THERAPEUTICS INC is a clinical-stage immunology-based drug discovery and development company focused on discovering, developing and commercializing oral small molecule therapeutics for inflammatory diseases and oncology. Headquartered in South San Francisco, California, the company is developing therapeutics that target key immune drivers to treat immune-mediated diseases, including atopic dermatitis, asthma, and certain cancers. RAPT's approach is to target chemokine receptors and other key signaling pathways to modulate the immune system and restore homeostasis.

name: RAYTHEON TECHNOLOGIES CORP
summary: RAYTHEON TECHNOLOGIES CORP is an aerospace and defense company that provides advanced technology and services to governments and commercial customers worldwide. Headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company operates through four segments: Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, Raytheon Intelligence & Space, and Raytheon Missiles & Defense. Raytheon Technologies develops and manufactures a wide range of products, including aircraft engines, avionics, cybersecurity solutions, missiles, and radar systems.

name: Rekor Systems, Inc.
summary: REKOR SYSTEMS INC is a technology company focused on developing and deploying artificial intelligence (AI)-powered solutions for smart cities, public safety, and intelligent transportation. Headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, the company's Rekor One platform provides real-time actionable intelligence through automated license plate recognition (ALPR) and other AI-based analytics. Rekor's solutions help customers improve situational awareness, enhance security, and optimize operations.

name: REVOLUTION MEDICINES INC
summary: REVOLUTION MEDICINES INC is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel therapies for RAS-addicted cancers. Headquartered in Redwood City, California, the company is developing a pipeline of small molecule inhibitors that target the RAS signaling pathway, which is frequently mutated in cancer. Revolution Medicines aims to address unmet medical needs in RAS-driven cancers by developing more effective and targeted therapies.

name: Reynolds Consumer Products Inc
summary: REYNOLDS CONSUMER PRODUCTS I is a consumer packaged goods company that manufactures and sells branded and private-label products. Headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois, the company's portfolio includes products such as Reynolds Wrap aluminum foil, Hefty trash bags, and EZ Foil disposable bakeware. Reynolds Consumer Products aims to provide high-quality and convenient solutions for household needs.

name: Scholastic Corporation
summary: SCHOLASTIC CORP is a publishing and education company that provides books, magazines, and digital resources for children and educators. Headquartered in New York, New York, the company operates through three segments: Children's Book Publishing and Distribution, Education Solutions, and International. Scholastic aims to foster literacy and a lifelong love of reading among children and young adults.

name: SCULPTOR CAPITAL MANAGEMENT
summary: SCULPTOR CAPITAL MANAGEMENT is an alternative asset management firm. Headquartered in New York, NY, the company manages investments across a range of strategies, including credit, real estate, and equities. Sculptor Capital Management provides investment solutions to institutional and high-net-worth investors.

name: SCYNEXIS, Inc.
summary: SCYNEXIS INC is a biotechnology company focused on developing and commercializing novel anti-infectives to address unmet medical needs. Headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey, the company's lead product is BREXAFEMME® (ibrexafungerp), an oral antifungal approved for the treatment of vulvovaginal candidiasis (VVC). SCYNEXIS aims to develop and commercialize innovative therapies for serious and life-threatening fungal infections.

name: SEAGEN INC
summary: SEAGEN INC is a biotechnology company focused on developing and commercializing innovative therapies for cancer. Headquartered in Bothell, Washington, the company is a pioneer in antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology, developing and commercializing ADCs for the treatment of hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. Seagen's pipeline includes several clinical-stage product candidates targeting a variety of cancer types.

name: Second Sight Medical Products,
summary: Second Sight Medical Products, Inc. develops, manufactures, and markets implantable visual prosthetics that are intended to deliver artificial vision to blind individuals. It develops technologies to treat the population of sight-impaired individuals. The company offers the Orion Visual Cortical Prosthesis System, an implanted cortical stimulation device, which is intended to provide useful artificial vision to individuals who are blind due to various causes, including glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, optic nerve injury or disease, and eye injury. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Sylmar, California.

name: SelectQuote Inc
summary: SELECTQUOTE INC is a direct-to-consumer insurance marketplace that provides consumers with unbiased price comparisons from multiple insurance carriers. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, the company offers a range of insurance products, including term life, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, and auto and home insurance. SelectQuote aims to simplify the insurance shopping process and help consumers find the best coverage at the best price.

name: SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc.
summary: SELLAS LIFE SCIENCES GROUP I is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel immunotherapies for cancer. Headquartered in New York, New York, the company is developing galinpepimut-S (GPS), a peptide-based immunotherapy targeting WT1, a tumor-associated antigen present in a variety of cancers. SELLAS aims to improve outcomes for patients with cancer through innovative immunotherapeutic approaches.

name: SENESTECH INC
summary: SENESTECH INC is a pest management company focused on developing and commercializing non-lethal fertility control solutions for managing rodent populations. Headquartered in Flagstaff, Arizona, the company's ContraPest® product is a liquid bait that reduces rodent reproduction by affecting both male and female fertility. SenesTech aims to provide humane and environmentally friendly solutions for rodent control.

name: SENSEI BIOTHERAPEUTICS INC
summary: SENSEI BIOTHERAPEUTICS INC is an immunotherapy company focused on developing vaccines and T cell therapies to treat cancer. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, the company is developing its ImmunoPhage™ platform, which is designed to stimulate the immune system to recognize and kill cancer cells. Sensei Bio aims to improve outcomes for patients with cancer through innovative immunotherapeutic approaches.

name: SHIFT TECHNOLOGIES INC
summary: SHIFT TECHNOLOGIES INC is an end-to-end auto ecommerce platform transforming the car-buying experience. In addition, it offers employee benefit insurance products; reinsurance services; and non-claims and ancillary services to the farmers' exchanges. It serves individuals, small businesses, and mid-sized and large companies, as well as multinational corporations. The company sells its products through agents, brokers, and bank distribution channels. Zurich Insurance Group AG was founded in 1872 and is based in Zurich, Switzerland.

name: Gevo Inc. Registered Shares DL
summary: Gevo, Inc. is a renewable fuels company focused on the production of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and other renewable hydrocarbons. They utilize proprietary technology to convert renewable resources, such as corn, into sustainable alternatives to traditional petroleum-based fuels. The company is headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, USA.

name: Fidelity Natl Inform.Svcs Inc.R
summary: Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (FIS) is a global provider of financial technology solutions for merchants, banks, and capital markets firms. They offer a broad range of services, including payment processing, banking software, and wealth management solutions. The company is headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, USA.

name: AB Siauliu Bankas
summary: AB Siauliu Bankas is a Lithuanian bank providing a range of financial services to individuals, small and medium-sized enterprises, and corporate clients. These services include lending, deposit taking, payment processing, and investment products. The bank is headquartered in Siauliai, Lithuania.

name: Zhejiang Expressway Co. Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Expressway Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company that operates and manages expressways in Zhejiang Province. They generate revenue from toll fees collected from vehicles using their expressway network. The company plays a vital role in the transportation infrastructure of the region.

name: ElringKlinger AG
summary: ElringKlinger AG develops, manufactures, and distributes technical and chemical products for the automotive sector and the general manufacturing industry in Germany and internationally. It operates through four segments: Original Equipment, Aftermarket, Engineered Plastics, and Other. The Original Equipment segment is involved in the development, manufacture, and sale of products and assemblies, such as metal sealing systems and drive train components; thermoplastics for drivetrains, body, and underbody applications; hybrid technologies; thermal, acoustic, and aerodynamic shielding systems; cylinder-head and specialty gaskets; battery and fuel cell components and systems; electric drive units; and exhaust gas purification. This segment serves passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors. The Aftermarket segment offers a range of gaskets, gasket sets, and service parts for the repair of engines, transmissions, exhaust systems, and auxiliary units in cars and commercial vehicles under the Elring – Das Original brand. This segment serves a network of wholesalers and purchasing organizations. The Engineered Plastics segment develops, manufactures, and markets customized products made from various plastics for the mechanical engineering sector, as well as in medical, chemical, energy, and vehicle industries. The Other segment operates engine test benches and measuring equipment for testing engines, transmissions, and exhaust systems for vehicle manufacturers and automotive suppliers; and offers logistics and catering services. The company was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Dettingen an der Erms, Germany.

name: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc.
summary: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. is a global medical device company that designs, manufactures, and markets orthopedic reconstructive products; sports medicine, biologics, extremities and trauma products; office-based technologies; spine, craniomaxillofacial and thoracic products; and dental implants. Their products are used by surgeons and dentists. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana, USA.

name: JinkoSolar Holding Co. Ltd. Reg
summary: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. is a global leader in the solar industry, manufacturing and selling solar modules, solar cells, and silicon wafers. They also provide engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for solar power projects. The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Zumiez Inc.
summary: Zumiez Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a specialty retailer of apparel, footwear, accessories, and hardgoods for young men and women. Its hardgoods include skateboards, snowboards, bindings, components, and other equipment. As of March 6, 2021, the company operated 722 stores, including 602 stores in the United States, 52 stores in Canada, 54 stores in Europe, and 14 stores in Australia under the names of Zumiez, Blue Tomato, and Fast Times. It also operates zumiez.com, zumiez.ca, blue-tomato.com, and fasttimes.com.au e-commerce websites. Zumiez Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Lynnwood, Washington.

name: CMC Metals Ltd.
summary: CMC Metals Ltd. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. The company explores for silver, zinc, lead, gold, copper, antimony, bismuth, and tungsten deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the Silver Hart property consisting of 116 contiguous full and partial mineral claims covering an area of 2,200 hectares located in the Watson Lake Mining District, Yukon Territories; and Logjam Property, comprising of 32 claims that covers an area of 632 hectares located in south-central Yukon. The company also holds an option to earn up to a 100% working interest in the Blue Heaven Property consisting of 118 contiguous full and partial claims, which cover 1,975 hectares located in the Rancheria Silver District, Yukon Territories; the Terra Nova Property that consists of 71 claims covering an area of approximately 1,775 hectares located in the Gander Subzone in Central Newfoundland; and Rancheria South Property that comprises of 12 mineral tenures covering an area of 2008.32 hectares. In addition, it holds option to acquire 100% Bridal Veil Property, consisting of 150 claims, which covers an area of 3,150 hectares located in Newfoundland. The company was formerly known as Bellevue Capital Corp. and changed its name to CMC Metals Ltd. in July 2005. CMC Metals Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Mkango Resources Ltd.
summary: Mkango Resources Ltd., through its subsidiary, Lancaster Exploration Limited, explores for and develops rare earth elements and associated minerals in the Republic of Malawi, Africa. It explores for uranium, niobium, tantalum, zircon, nickel, cobalt, and gold ores. The company's principal project is the Songwe Hill property within the Phalombe exploration license, which covers an area of 849.1 square kilometers located in southeast Malawi. It also holds 100% interests in the Thambani, Chimimbe Hill, and Mchinji licenses. Mkango Resources Ltd. is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Maisons du Monde SA
summary: Maisons du Monde S.A., through its subsidiaries, creates and distributes home decoration items and furniture in France and internationally. The company's decorative products include bedding, rugs and mats, candles, pillows and cushions, clocks, tableware, lamps, kitchenware, mirrors and frames, vases, storage articles, window treatments, and bath products, as well as household textiles; and baby crib mobiles, lamps, storage containers, and wall art for children. It also provides furniture, such as sofas, chairs, beds, mattresses and bedframes, floor lamps, tables, and junior furniture; and tables and storage units comprising bookshelves, wardrobes, and cupboards. In addition, the company offers warehouse logistics and order preparation, and customer delivery services, as well as container transport services between harbor and warehouses. As of December 31, 2019, it operated 376 stores in nine countries; and an e-commerce platform. The company also offers its products through four catalogues covering general, outdoor furniture, junior, and B2B. It provides its products under the Maisons du Monde brand. The company was formerly known as Magnolia (BC) SAS. Maisons du Monde S.A. founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Vertou, France.

name: CHINA SOUTHERN AIRLINES CO.LTDR
summary: CHINA SOUTHERN AIRLINES CO.LTDR is one of China's largest airlines, operating a comprehensive network of domestic and international routes. The airline provides passenger and cargo transportation services. The company is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: China Southern Airlines Co.LtdR
summary: China Southern Airlines Co.LtdR is one of China's largest airlines, operating a comprehensive network of domestic and international routes. The airline provides passenger and cargo transportation services. The company is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: zooplus AG
summary: zooplus AG operates as an online retailer of pet products. The company offers wet and dry food, feed additives, and snacks for dogs and cats under the Concept for Life, Wolf of Wilderness, Wild Freedom, Purizon, Rocco, Cosma, Lukullus, and Feringa brands, as well as Briantos, My Star, Smilla, and Tigerino brands; and specialty articles, such as toys, scratch trees, transport baskets, grooming and care products, bedding, and other accessories. It provides approximately 8,000 food and accessory products for dogs, cats, small animals, birds, aquarium, and horses. The company sells its products in Germany and internationally. zooplus AG was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.

name: TIS Inc.
summary: TIS Inc. provides information technology (IT) services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Service IT Business, BPO, Financial IT Services, Industrial IT Services, and Other segments. The Service IT Business segment provides knowledge-intensive IT services to create universalized and template-oriented solutions, such as default configuration and ERP for clients. The BPO segment offers business process outsourcing services, including marketing and sales services; and office and contract operations. The Financial IT Services segment offers value-added services for client's operations, expand use of IT, and IT-based support services for financial sector. The Industrial IT Business segment value-added services for client's operations, expand use of IT, and IT-based support services for non-financial sector. The Others segment provides leasing and other information systems. The company serves clients in the credit card, banking, insurance and other financial, manufacturing, distribution, service, public, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as IT Holdings Corporation and changed its name to TIS Inc. in July 2016. TIS Inc. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SBI Holdings Inc. Registered Sh
summary: SBI Holdings Inc. Registered Sh is a Japanese financial services group offering a wide range of services including securities, banking, and insurance. The company also has a significant presence in asset management and venture capital investments. SBI Holdings is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: Timkensteel Corp. Registered Sh
summary: Timkensteel Corp. Registered Sh is a manufacturer of alloy steel, as well as carbon and micro-alloyed steel, primarily serving demanding applications. The company produces special bar quality (SBQ) steel bars, seamless mechanical tubing, and precision components. TimkenSteel is headquartered in Canton, Ohio, USA.

name: FinecoBank Banca Fineco S.p.A.
summary: FinecoBank Banca Fineco S.p.A. provides banking and investment products and services. The company operates through Banking, Brokerage, and Investing segments. The company offers banking services, including current account and deposit services, payment services, mortgages, and personal loans, as well as debit, credit, and prepaid cards; and brokerage services comprising order execution services on behalf of customers with direct access to global equity markets, as well as to trade on currencies, indices, shares, bonds, commodities, futures, options, bonds, ETFs, and certificates. The company also provides asset management services, such as placement and distribution services of various products, including mutual funds and SICAV sub-funds, and insurance and pension products, as well as investment advisory services. It serves primarily through a network of personal financial advisors, and online and mobile channels. As of December 31, 2020, the company operated 410 financial shops. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Reggio Emilia, Italy.

name: Scorpio Gold Corporation
summary: Scorpio Gold Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploitation, exploration, and development of mineral resource properties in the United States. The company primarily explores for gold and silver deposits. It holds interests in the Mineral Ridge gold project covering an area of 5,617 hectares located in Esmeralda County, Nevada; and Goldwedge property that covers an area of 726 hectares located in Manhattan, Nevada. The company also holds 100% interest in the Manhattan property covering an area of 4,300 acres located in Nye Country, Nevada. Scorpio Gold Corporation is headquartered in White Rock, Canada.

name: AB Snaige
summary: AB Snaige, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells refrigerators and refrigerating equipment under the SNAIGE brand name primarily in Lithuania. The company offers combined refrigerators with separate external doors, single cooler refrigerators, and freezers; commercial refrigerators for businesses, hotels, and restaurants; spare parts for refrigerators, and tools and equipment; refrigerator-showcases; and wine refrigerators. It also exports its products to approximately 30 countries. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Alytus, Lithuania. AB Snaige is a subsidiary of Sekenora Holdings Limited.

name: Sirona Biochem Corp.
summary: Sirona Biochem Corp., a cosmetic ingredient and drug discovery company, develops and sells cosmetic and pharmaceutical active ingredients in Canada and France. It develops programs in the areas of diabetes, anti-inflammatories, and anti-infectives for therapeutics; and anti-aging and depigmenting agents in cosmeceuticals. The company was formerly known as High Rider Capital Inc. and changed its name to Sirona Biochem Corp. in May 2009. Sirona Biochem Corp. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Sharps Compliance Corp.
summary: Sharps Compliance Corp. provides medical, pharmaceutical, and hazardous waste management services in the United States. It offers Sharps Recovery System for the containment, transportation, treatment, and tracking of medical waste generated outside the hospital and health care facility settings; TakeAway Recovery System to treat used needles, syringes, and other used healthcare products; Route-Based Pickup Service, a medical and hazardous waste pick-up services; and MedSafe, a solution for the safe collection, transportation, and disposal of unwanted and expired ultimate-user medications. The company also provides TakeAway Medication Recovery System that facilitates the proper disposal of unused medications; Black Pail Program for Rx, a solution with minimal segregation for the disposal of various pharmaceuticals; Inhaler Disposal to collect, transport, and destroy used pharmaceutical inhalers; Hazardous Drug Spill Control Kit for the cleanup of chemotherapy and other HD spills; TakeAway Recycle System for the collection and recycling of single-use medical devices from surgical centers and other healthcare facilities; ComplianceTRAC, a Web-based compliance and training program; and Universal Waste Shipback Systems to collect, transport, and recycle light bulbs, batteries, and other mercury containing devices. In addition, it offers other solutions, such as TakeAway Environmental Return System, SharpsTracer, Sharps Secure, Needle Disposal System, Complete Needle Collection and Disposal System, Pitch-It IV Poles, Asset Return System, and Spill Kit Recovery System, as well as Sharps MWMS, a medical waste management system. The company serves customers in home health care, retail clinics and immunizing pharmacies, pharmaceutical manufacturers, professional offices, assisted living and long-term care facilities, and government agencies, as well as distributors. Sharps Compliance Corp. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

name: SunOpta Inc.
summary: SunOpta Inc. manufactures and sells plant-based and fruit-based food and beverage products to retail customers, foodservice distributors, branded food companies, and food manufacturers worldwide. The company operates through two segments, Plant-Based Foods and Beverages, and Fruit-Based Foods and Beverages. The Plant-Based Foods and Beverages segment provides plant-based beverages, and liquid and dry ingredients that utilizes almond, soy, coconut, oat, hemp, and other bases, as well as broths, teas, and nutritional beverages. This segment also packages dry- and oil-roasted in-shell sunflower and sunflower kernels, as well as corn-, soy-, and legume-based roasted snacks; and processes and sells raw sunflower inshell and kernel for food and feed applications. The Fruit-Based Foods and Beverages segment offers individually quick frozen (IQF) fruits, such as strawberries, blueberries, mangos, pineapples, blends, and other berries for retail; and IQF and bulk frozen fruits, including purées, fruit cups, and smoothies for foodservice, and custom fruit preparations for industrial use. This segment also provides fruit snacks comprising bars, twists, ropes, and bite-sized products. The company was formerly known as Stake Technology Ltd. and changed its name to SunOpta Inc. in October 2003. SunOpta Inc. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Mississauga, Canada.

name: Solar Capital Ltd. Registered S
summary: Solar Capital Ltd. Registered S is a specialty finance company that invests in middle-market companies, primarily through direct lending and other debt instruments. The company provides financing solutions to companies for acquisitions, growth, and recapitalizations. Solar Capital is managed by Solar Capital Partners, LLC.

name: Solutiance AG
summary: Solutiance AG is a software and consulting company that provides IT solutions and services to businesses. Their offerings include software development, system integration, and IT consulting. The company is headquartered in Germany.

name: SSR Mining Inc.
summary: SSR Mining Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and operation of precious metal resource properties in Turkey and the Americas. The company explores for gold, silver, lead, and zinc deposits. Its projects include the Çöpler Gold mine located in Erzincan, Turkey; the Marigold mine located in Humboldt and Lander Counties, Nevada, the United States; the Seabee Gold Operation located in Saskatchewan, Canada; and the Puna Operations in Jujuy, Argentina. The company was formerly known as Silver Standard Resources Inc. and changed its name to SSR Mining Inc. in August 2017. SSR Mining Inc. was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Zebra Technologies Corporation Class A
summary: ZEBRA TECHNOLOGIES CORP. Regist designs, manufactures, and sells barcode printers, mobile computers, and related products. The company's products are used for tracking and managing assets, transactions, and people in various industries, including retail, healthcare, and logistics. Zebra Technologies is headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois.

name: ZTO Express (Cayman), Inc. Sponsored ADR Class A
summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. Reg.S is a leading express delivery company in China, providing package delivery services through its nationwide network. The company utilizes a network partner model, leveraging local expertise and infrastructure. ZTO Express is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, in the research, development, designs, manufactures, and sells railway transportation equipment products, and provision of relevant services primarily in Mainland China and internationally. The company also produces propulsion and control systems for trains and electric vehicles, signaling systems, power supply solutions, platform screen doors, rail maintenance vehicles, marine engineering equipment, and component products for various applications. Its products for rolling stock and railways include EMU, locomotive, and mass transit systems; and components products consist of semiconductors, resistors, reactors, radiators, sensors, power capacitors, and heatsinks. The company's energy and industrial products comprise marine engineering, electric vehicle, and inverter and converter systems, as well as provides railway maintenance and construction machines. The company was formerly known as Zhuzhou CSR Times Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd. in March 2016. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Wanchai, Hong Kong.

name: BANK F. TIROL U. VORARLBERG AGI
summary: BANK F. TIROL U. VORARLBERG AGI is Bank für Tirol und Vorarlberg AG (BTV), an Austrian regional bank providing a range of financial services. The bank offers services including retail banking, corporate banking, and investment services. BTV is headquartered in Innsbruck, Austria.

name: BANK F. TIROL U. VORARLBERG AGI
summary: BANK F. TIROL U. VORARLBERG AGI is Bank für Tirol und Vorarlberg AG (BTV), an Austrian regional bank providing a range of financial services. The bank offers services including retail banking, corporate banking, and investment services. BTV is headquartered in Innsbruck, Austria.

name: Cellectis Actions Nom. EO -,05
summary: Cellectis Actions Nom. EO -,05 is a French biopharmaceutical company focused on developing allogeneic CAR-T cell therapies for cancer. Their technology platform utilizes gene editing to create off-the-shelf CAR-T cell products. Cellectis is headquartered in Paris, France.

name: Cellectis Act.Nom.(Sp.ADRs)/1 E
summary: Cellectis Act.Nom.(Sp.ADRs)/1 E represents sponsored American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of Cellectis, a French biopharmaceutical company. Cellectis is focused on developing allogeneic CAR-T cell therapies for cancer utilizing gene editing technologies. The company is headquartered in Paris, France.

name: Zignago Vetro S.p.A. Azioni nom
summary: Zignago Vetro S.p.A. Azioni nom is an Italian company that manufactures glass containers for the food and beverage industry. They produce bottles and jars for various products. Zignago Vetro is headquartered in Fossalta di Portogruaro, Italy.

name: Indofood Agri Resources Ltd.
summary: Indofood Agri Resources Ltd. operates as a vertically integrated agribusiness company. The company engages in the research and development; oil palm seed breeding; oil palm plantations cultivation; crude palm oil production and refining; rubber sugar cane, cocoa, and tea cultivation; and industrial timber plantation activities. It operates in two segments, Plantations; and Edible Oils and Fats. The Plantations segment is involved in the development and maintenance of oil palm, rubber, and sugar cane plantations; and other business activities relating to processing, marketing, and selling palm oil, rubber, and sugar cane. The Edible Oils and Fats segment produces, markets, and sells edible oil, margarine, and shortening and other related products, as well as its derivative products. The company offers cooking oil under the Bimoli, Bimoli Spesial, Delima, and Happy brands; and margarine and shortening products under the Palmia, Simas, Amanda, Malinda, and Delima brands. As of December 31, 2019, it had a planted area of approximately 302,372 hectares, including 251,819 hectares of oil palm; 16,796 hectares of rubber; 13,543 hectares of sugar cane; and 20,214 hectares of other crops in Indonesia, as well as 85,969 hectares of planted sugar cane in Brazil. The company also owns and operates bulking facilities; provides transportation, investment, management, and technical services; and operates in the macronutrients mix fertilizers and prefabrication industries. In addition, it is involved in the fishing, trading, and industrial activities; and provision of agency services. Indofood Agri Resources Ltd. has operations in Indonesia, Singapore, China, Nigeria, Malaysia, the Philippines, Timor Leste, South Korea, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Singapore. Indofood Agri Resources Ltd. is a subsidiary of Indofood Singapore Holdings Pte. Ltd.

name: Zhaojin Mining Industry Co.LtdR
summary: Zhaojin Mining Industry Co.LtdR is a Chinese gold mining company engaged in the exploration, mining, smelting, and refining of gold. The company is one of the largest gold producers in China. Zhaojin Mining Industry is headquartered in Zhaoyuan, Shandong Province, China.

name: Solar A/S Navne Aktier B DK 100
summary: Solar A/S is a European sourcing and services company. The company provides electrical, heating, plumbing and ventilation products and related services to its customers, primarily installers and contractors. Solar A/S is headquartered in Vejen, Denmark.

name: Gem Diamonds Ltd. Registered Sh
summary: Gem Diamonds Ltd. is a diamond mining company focused on the extraction and sale of high-value diamonds. The company's primary asset is the Letšeng mine in Lesotho, known for producing large, high-quality diamonds. Gem Diamonds is headquartered in London.

name: FRASERS GROUP PLC
summary: Frasers Group plc is a retail conglomerate based in the UK with a diverse portfolio of sports, fashion, and lifestyle brands. The group operates through a network of retail stores and online platforms. Its main brands include Sports Direct, House of Fraser, and Flannels.

name: Telia Lietuva AB Registered Sha
summary: Telia Lietuva, AB provides integrated telecommunications services, including fixed-line, mobile, and internet services, primarily in Lithuania. The company offers a range of services to residential and business customers, focusing on innovation and customer satisfaction. Telia Lietuva is headquartered in Vilnius, Lithuania.

name: Zynga Inc.
summary: Zynga Inc. provides social game services in the United States and internationally. The company develops, markets, and operates social games as live services played on mobile platforms, such as Apple iOS and Google's Android operating systems; social networking platforms, such as Facebook and Snapchat; and personal computers consoles, such as Nintendo's Switch game console, and other platforms and consoles. It also provides advertising services comprising mobile advertisements, engagement advertisements and offers, and branded virtual items and sponsorships for marketers and advertisers; and licenses its own brands. The company was formerly known as Zynga Game Network Inc. and changed its name to Zynga Inc. in November 2010. Zynga Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: State Street Corporation
summary: State Street Corporation is a financial services and bank holding company that provides a range of services, including investment servicing, investment management, and investment research and trading, to institutional clients worldwide. The company's business model revolves around providing financial solutions and expertise to help clients manage their assets effectively. State Street is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

name: Nevada Copper Corp.
summary: Nevada Copper Corp. engages in the exploration, development, and operation of mineral properties in Nevada. The company explores for copper, gold, and silver ores. Its holds 100% interests in the Pumpkin Hollow property located in Nevada, the United States. Nevada Copper Corp. is based in Reno, Nevada.

name: Ascencio S.C.A. Actions Nom. o.
summary: Ascencio SCA is a real estate investment trust (REIT) specializing in commercial properties located on the outskirts of urban areas in Belgium, France, and Spain. The company focuses on investing in and managing retail sites, typically anchored by supermarkets. Ascencio is headquartered in Nivelles, Belgium.

name: Commerzbank AG
summary: Commerzbank AG provides banking and capital market services to private and small business customers, multinational groups, financial service providers, and institutional clients worldwide. It operates through two segments, Private and Small-Business Customers, and Corporate Clients. The company offers accounts, commercial payments, payment enabling, clearing and custody, and other services; trade services, including documentary collection, letters of credit, guarantees, trade facilitation, supply chain financing, buyer's credit, and forfaiting services; and bilateral loans, club deals, Schuldschein instruments, syndicated loans, bonds, private placements, other debt instruments, and Islamic financing services. It also provides money market, and commodities and precious metals products; interest, currency, and liquidity management services, as well as wealth management services. The company operates approximately 790 branches. Commerzbank AG was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.
